description.p: WinCtrl Config is a configuration tool for WinWing URSA MINOR joysticks on Linux. It reads and configures the on-board settings of the joystick and provides OS-side helpers that never write to the hardware.

ul.li: Identity, yaw-axis mode, deadzones and factory reset
Motor test and vibration effect curves
Button remapping and splitting into virtual controllers, to work around the 32-button limit of some games (OS-side, no write to the joystick)

description.p: Every write to the joystick memory requires an explicit confirmation, with an automatic backup taken first. Identity registers (name, PID, serial number) are protected and never written.
This is an unofficial, third-party project: not affiliated with, nor endorsed by WinWing. Provided "as is", without any warranty; writes to the hardware are performed at the user's own risk.

screenshot.caption: The General tab: joystick identity, deadzones and firmware
Axes: response curve, inversion and a draggable control point
Vibration: test the motor and edit generic response curves
Backlight: live brightness and lighting modes

description.p: First public beta: backlight, calibration, axis curves and inversion, vibration test, button remap and 4×32 split, profiles, firmware version check and flashing. English interface with a French translation.
